comparison.objective: Zero an unpowered robot joint and insert a calibration pin to support it.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a heavy link at an angular mark while aligning and inserting a rigid pin.
comparison.success_condition: Pin home with joint within 1 degree of zero, assembly still, and both grippers clear for one second.
comparison.reason: This tests simultaneous link support and alignment-pin insertion; the candidate instead tunes and locks a damper and proves repeated dynamic stopping performance.
